oracle: Independent BigInt arithmetic over unsigned 32-bit values and booleans
scope: Deterministic generated straight-line arithmetic/bitwise/select corpus with boundary values. Differential testing, not exhaustive proof or real-application performance evidence.

javascript.detail: Executed emitted ES module in Node; public input guards retained.

native_c_clang.detail: native C via clang; undefined-behavior sanitizer enabled; C++ path compiles the C-compatible output, not a C++ frontend.

native_c_gcc.detail: native C via gcc (on macOS `gcc` may be Apple clang; see tool field); undefined-behavior sanitizer enabled; C++ path compiles the C-compatible output, not a C++ frontend.

native_cpp_clang.detail: C-compatible output compiled as C++17 via clang++; undefined-behavior sanitizer enabled; C++ path compiles the C-compatible output, not a C++ frontend.

native_arm64.detail: native arm64 assembly (src/arm64.ts) via `clang -x assembler`, linked with the C test driver; 10 io functions (965 cases) skipped: io is out of scope for this backend; optimized and unoptimized emissions each executed on every case

native_x86_64.detail: native x86-64 assembly (src/x86_64.ts) via `clang -x assembler`, linked with the C test driver; 10 io functions (965 cases) skipped: io is out of scope for this backend; executed under Rosetta 2 (arch -x86_64); optimized and unoptimized emissions each executed on every case

native_riscv64.detail: native RISC-V RV64 assembly (src/riscv64.ts) via `riscv64-elf-gcc -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64`, linked with the C test driver over a bare-metal libc shim (UART out, embedded input), executed under qemu-system-riscv64 (virt board, no firmware); 10 io functions (965 cases) skipped: io is out of scope for this backend; optimized and unoptimized emissions each executed on every case

native_avr.detail: native AVR assembly for the ATmega328P (src/avr.ts) via avr-as, linked with an avr-gcc C driver per function (cases in program memory, results on UART0), executed under libsimavr; 10 io functions (965 cases) skipped: io is out of scope for this backend; every io-free function fits the part; optimized and unoptimized emissions each executed on every case run

webassembly.detail: Emitted C compiled by Clang/wasm-ld to wasm32; executed in Node WebAssembly runtime.

webassembly_direct.detail: A0 wasm32 backend (src/wasm.ts): binary module emitted directly, no C/Clang/wasm-ld; executed in Node WebAssembly runtime with the C-derived harness; optimized and unoptimized emissions each executed on every case

jvm.detail: Generated Java compiled with javac; bytecode executed on JVM.

systemverilog.detail: SystemVerilog is emitted here but validated separately by `bun run hw` (results/hardware.json).

elapsedMeaning: Includes emission/build/startup/checking for each path; not a comparative runtime benchmark.
